title: El Niño hits 9,348 families, damages 422 hectares in Iligan

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The prolonged dry spell from El Niño has affected 9,348 families and damaged 422 hectares of farmland in Iligan City, according to the latest consolidated findings of the city’s Rapid Damage Assessment and Needs Analysis (RDANA). The report showed that the affected families, from 17 barangays, accounted for 11.16 percent of the city’s 83,773 households based on the 2024 Community-Based Monitoring System (CBMS) data. The affected farmland, meanwhile, represents approximately 0.52 percent of the city’s total agricultural land area of 81,337 hectares.
